command: set -eu; SRC_SCRIPT=werkzeug/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh; SRC_CONF=werkzeug/entityos-vm-volatile-state-guard.conf; DST_SCRIPT=/usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh; DST_CONF=/etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/10-volatile-state-guard.conf; do sudo -n sha256sum "$f"; done | tee /tmp/omega_guard_db_post.sha256; cmp -s /tmp/omega_guard_db_pre.sha256 /tmp/omega_guard_db_post.sha256; echo DB_HASHES_IDENTICAL; echo GUARD_INSTALL_PASS
